scope: Metadata-only custody qualification for the R3503 harness repair; no new validation or product-source review.

initial_probe_source.qualification: The exact pre-repair probe body is unavailable as a retained file. The initial source hash is retained in R3503-pins.json, and its failed execution's stdout, stderr, exit code, and timestamps are retained in probe.*. repaired_probe_source.measurement_timing: This hash was measured after the harness correction and before the repaired probe execution; it was also recomputed after that execution with the same value.
repaired_probe_source.status: The repaired source hash and repaired execution raws remain retained.
